faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIBF In-charge, Professional Development Centre recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the IIBF In-charge, Professional Development Centre position is 21 September 2026. Ensure all details are accurate before the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the minimum and maximum age limit for this post?
faq.answer: The minimum age requirement is 55 years, and the maximum age limit is 62 years as of 01 September 2026. Candidates must adhere to these age criteria.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the In-charge, Professional Development Centre position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 1,25,000/-. This is a competitive remuneration package for the role.

faq.question: Q4. What are the educational qualifications required?
faq.answer: Applicants must possess a Graduate degree along with CA/CMA/CFA and CAIIB. Alternatively, a 2-year MBA/PGDBA/PGDBM in Banking & Finance or a related Ph.D. is acceptable.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive. Candidates can apply without any financial obligation.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is only one vacancy for the post of In-charge, Professional Development Centre at the Gift City, Gandhinagar location.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for this role?
faq.answer: The selection process primarily involves a Personal Interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their performance in the interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The position of In-charge, Professional Development Centre is offered on a Contract basis.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the location of the job?
faq.answer: The job location is Gandhinagar, Gujarat, specifically at the Gift City.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates from other states apply?
faq.answer: The notification mentions inviting applications from eligible candidates in Gujarat. It is advisable to check the official notification for any specific state domicile requirements.
